summary: Bel Fuse Inc. filed an 8-K solely to recast audited historical segment information from its 2025 Form 10-K due to a strategic realignment of reportable segments effective Q1 2026, splitting operations into Aerospace, Defense & Rugged Solutions and Industrial Technology & Data Solutions. This realignment had no impact on consolidated financials. No transaction, price, or deal mechanics are involved. The filing is a technical compliance update. No further action or risk-arb angle applies.
